title: Time-step strategy selector
overview: timestepModel selects the time-step strategy in the audited unstructured Navier-Stokes path. The implementation uses 0 for local, 1 for global, and the remaining branch for local/global hybrid stepping; representative case comments label value 2 as lg.
principle: The selector dispatches cell time-step construction: local keeps per-cell values; global fills cells from ctrl.pdt; the hybrid branch computes local values and replaces them with their minimum as a common step.
architecture: NsCom::Init reads timestepModel. UTimeStep::CalcTimeStep dispatches the CPU path and gates the supported HIP path to local mode 0. The hybrid fallback is broader than the documented case value 2; it is not a strict enum validator.

proves: The audited unstructured path dispatches 0 to local, 1 to global, and all other values to the local/global hybrid branch.
The supported HIP path is gated to local mode 0.
does_not_prove: That every solver or backend supports all strategies.
That invalid selector values are rejected; the fallback branch handles all remaining values.
That a selected strategy guarantees stability or convergence.

verification.scope: Source-level strategy dispatch; no end-to-end solver run is claimed.

examples.title: Strategy dispatch
examples.calculation: 0 selects local cell steps; 1 selects the configured global step; 2 enters the local/global hybrid fallback.
examples.result: The three documented case modes map to distinct time-step construction paths.
examples.limitations: The implementation's final else branch accepts every value other than 0 and 1; this is not validation of the value 2 only.

formulas.title: Time-step strategy dispatch
formulas.plain: S(m) = local if m = 0; global if m = 1; local-global otherwise
formulas.assumptions: Describes the audited unstructured UTimeStep::CalcTimeStep dispatch. The final else branch is broader than the documented case value 2.

caveats: The supported HIP path is currently restricted to local mode 0.
The selector is not validated as a closed enumeration by the dispatch branch.
